If you’re at all interested in this game, avoid any spoilers, download it, and play it IMMEDIATELY. This game is good enough with just its roguelike card battler mechanics, but it comes with a twist that will keep you coming back until you finally beat it. I’ll keep it short and sweet: great game mechanics, immersive story, and brilliant twists in both the gameplay and narrative. It’ll keep you on your toes. So build an OP deck and get on your way. You’ve got a file to continue.
Really enjoyed this game. Even if you're not a fan of card games, the story, atmosphere and lore within this game make it an awesome playthrough. Give it a try.

An intense ride of plot-twisting and story telling. Never been this deeply intrigued by the secrets unfolding in any kind of entertainment. The whole atmosphere, visuals and sounds can honestly not be any better.

When even reviewers refuses to let people know what makes the game so captivating just because it might alter your experience, then you should understand that there is something
worth engaging.

Truely a masterpiece.

I really enjoy inscription, the game and the arg, I have so many more hours on my xbox than here, but it's one of my favorite video-card games to sit down and go through a few runs and the lore is also so cool.

I don't normally write reviews, but for this game I felt I had to. There wasn't a single moment of this game in which I wasn't actively engaged in both the gameplay and the story, and the massive changes in style both graphically and mechanically definitely keep you guessing, as well as the story which oddly weaves itself throughout. the ONLY complaint I can genuinely lodge against this game is that there isn't more of it. 100% would recommend. Despite the shot play time (I beat it entirely in less than 9 hours) I would GLADLY buy it again.

Not many games today have true creative vision. This game has so many layers that you slowly peel away as the game goes on. You realize it is not simply a card playing game. With fun game play, witty puzzles and somber atmosphere, this game is a gem. I would highly recommend picking this game up. Look nothing up, ask no one for help, just play it and you will not be disappointed.

This game gets weirder and weirder the deeper you get into it. I've played a lot of deck builder style games, but this is like nothing I have experienced before. If you decide to buy, I would strongly advise going in blind to avoid spoilers. Don't read or watch anything about the gameplay or story. Just install and let 'er rip. If you like deck builders, you're going to love this game. Trust me.

It feels like someone put a number of popular indie tropes together in a game without understanding how they worked in their own contexts, or how they'd work when put together.

While there are several story elements scattered throughout the game, none of them get anything that comes close to a satisfying resolution. The ending comes out of nowhere, and neither addresses nor solves nothing, all while acting like it's revealed some major twist.

In short, it feels like an identity crisis.
I absolutely love this game! I've played through entirely once and between Kaycee's mod and being able to redo the first chapter whenever, I get a lot of replay value out of it.

Death becomes you.

Gather cards. Trust the Stoat. Form strategies. Look around the room. Face bosses. Sacrifice cards to gain better cards. Solve puzzles in the room. improve your cards by the fire. Watch your favourite card get eaten next to the fire. Gain boons found around the room. Gain trinkets. Punch your adversaries teeth out. Keep said teeth to trade them for pelts. Trade the pelts for better cards. Sacrifice more cards but this time to shift a cards power to a card more deserving. Don't trust the Stoat. If you like your deck, put a ring on it.

Die again. and again. and again. and again. and again. and again.

My dumbass took way longer than I should have trying to beat Leshy but this game is a masterpiece in terms of its design and mechanics. It is not easy to guess the motivation of characters but the plot twists do not feel insane or way too unexpected. Even though it changes drastically three times, the art of this game makes me explode internally in a good way--It felt messy initially but the way it comes together at the end makes it all worth it. It is such a beautiful and insane game.

been trying out card based games lately and this was great to be frank! It not only has puzzles and engages the player to think deeper than just setting up a deck to win; but also there's a story which makes you want to figure out whats going on! what an amazing design by the dev's i couldn't recommend this game more!

Def get this game if you're thinking about it even if you aren't that into Card based games, if you like strategy in general you'll enjoy the puzzles that's riddled throughout the game!

THIS GAME IS AN EXPERIENCE.

If you don't enjoy the gameplay of the first 2 hours or find the tone too dark or weird, you probably won't like the rest. If you're not offput too much by that, I think you will be blown away by what you expereince over the next 10-15 hours. The story is okay but the way it's told is fantastic and some of the game systems are so creative. Worth the price to play until the credits roll *if* you enjoy deck builders/puzzles and don't mind some dark tones. There's also a challenge mode available after story completion but I don't like the core gameplay that much. It's fine but it's not the star of the show.
The game is just beautiful, good story and interesting mechanics, not a normal card game for sure 10/10

The emotional attachment I feel towards this game and its content is unlike any I have experienced before. The characters are fleshed out to the point where they feel real, and wether moral or immoral, that's what makes them believable.

Its several mechanics can seem a bit tricky in the beginning, but it's all based on strategy and a smidge of luck. Failing is never the end.

I recommend you play this game and take a look at the ARG that follows with it.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (97%): players love the story and characters, which 45% of reviews praise.
Complaints are few and spread across different topics, with no single one standing out.

details.text: Reviews from the last 30 days are 94% positive, a little below the all-time score.
Players with under 2 hours are far less positive than long-time players, at 78% positive, so early impressions may differ.
